name: Genghis Khan
hook: The Mongol conqueror, his empire, his grandsons, and his surprising screen career.

facts.label: Temüjin
facts.statement: Genghis Khan was born Temüjin around 1162 and was proclaimed supreme ruler in 1206.

facts.label: the united Mongol tribes
facts.statement: He united the Mongol tribes and led them into China in the 13th century.

facts.label: Beijing
facts.statement: In 1215 his Mongol horde sacked Beijing, the Chin capital, which burned for a month.

facts.label: Kublai Khan
facts.statement: His grandson Kublai Khan became the first emperor of China's Yuan Dynasty in 1279.

facts.label: the Genghis Khan Statue Complex
facts.statement: The Genghis Khan Statue Complex stands about 35 miles west of Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia's capital.

facts.label: The Conqueror
facts.statement: John Wayne played Genghis Khan in the 1956 film The Conqueror.

facts.label: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
facts.statement: Genghis Khan appears in Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure, where Keanu Reeves asks, "Want a Twinkie, Genghis Khan?"
